description: Social media-style activity feed dashboard showing listings + reviews from followed users merged with own activity. Replaces old 'my listings table + inquiries' layout. Includes compose box, stats strip, and feed items.

elements.label: Compose input
elements.purpose: Placeholder text for future post creation — avatar + 'Share a project idea...'

elements.label: Stats bar
elements.purpose: 3-column: Your posts, Posts in feed, New alerts

elements.label: Activity stream
elements.purpose: Vertical list of ActivityPost cards: avatar, actor name + action verb, listing title, description snippet, category tag, price, relative time (e.g. '2h ago')
elements.schema_column_mapping: listings.title, listings.description, listings.price, categories.label, users.name, listings.created_at

elements.label: Empty feed prompt
elements.purpose: Icon + message encouraging follow/discover when no followed users exist
